item.name: FDA approvals, clinical trials, and PDUFA dates

request.name: FDA approvals, clinical trials, and PDUFA dates

description.content: Returns FDA approvals, clinical trials, and PDUFA (Prescription Drug User Fee Act) dates for pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Includes information about drug development stages, trial results, approval outcomes, and regulatory milestones.

Some date fields (such as the FDA calendar target date) include fuzzy dates such as 2021-Q1. When filtering, you may choose to allow fuzzy date matching, or strict date matching that searches for ONLY dates that have an exact match within the given date period. Default `TRUE`
One or more security identifiers separated by a comma. Maximum 50 securities. Security identifiers must be in the format of ticker symbols, only for US-listed equities
